Definition: a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
KeyPassages: 1 Kings 7:19; Hosea 14:5; Song of Solomon 4:5; Song of Solomon 7:2
BiblicalUsage: Shushan is the lily, white and clean, and it crowns the temple's pillars with lily work, grows as the dew waters Israel, and fills the Song with its beauty. The beloved's breasts feed among the lilies, and her body is a heap of wheat set about with lilies.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lily is God's picture of a life that grows without striving. It does not toil or spin, and I hold that the Lord who clothes the lily will clothe me too.
